note: Sanitized mflux profiles for local image generation. This is a separate layer from the oMLX profiles in omlx-profiles.json: oMLX serves the text LLMs, mflux runs the diffusion models. No API keys or secrets included.

klein-q8.name: klein-q8
klein-q8.license_note: Apache-2.0. No output restrictions beyond the licence's own terms.

quantization.note: The level is stored in the weights, so no --quantize flag is needed.

klein-q8.compute_precision_note: Apple M1 family has no native bfloat16, so MLX's matmul and attention kernels are fastest in float16. The residual stream, norms, text encoder and VAE keep the model's own precision. On an M1 Max mflux measured FLUX.2 klein 4B (q4) at 6.8 -> 5.0 s/step (-22%) with this flag. It changes the image slightly for a given seed, so a run records it.

quantization.note: Uploader-modified: transformer at 8-bit, text encoder truncated to layers 0-31 and quantized to 8-bit. The level is in the weights, so no --quantize flag is needed.
